title: The Last Gift
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Kogoro Mouri, Ran, Inspector, Detective Takagi) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. Discrepancies vs. the old cases/ep840_the_last_gift.json file: (1) the old file's e1 event ('Katsui was supposed to kill Hirose but failed') is not supported anywhere in the transcript -- invented, dropped here; (2) the old file's object o1 was a 'clock, reset to falsify the time of death' but the transcript is explicit the manipulated timepiece is Katsui's own wristwatch, which Hirose set to 8:00 and broke, not a clock; (3) the old file's motive_type undersells the plot -- Hirose's scheme was two-layered: she killed Katsui to end his blackmail, then deliberately let herself look guilty of an 8 PM murder (a time she could not have committed it) specifically to make her ex-boyfriend Matsubayashi, the one person who could clear her, either stay silent (letting an innocent woman go to prison, out of self-interest) or come forward (wrecking his engagement) -- either way a 'last gift' of psychological revenge for his abandoning her for a richer woman. Both motives are represented as separate has_motive_against edges. case_type: murder.

clues.desc: Ten cigarette butts plus an unsmoked pack, all print-matched to Katsui, inside a trash bag print-matched to Hirose -- proves Katsui spent hours waiting alive inside Hirose's apartment, not killed at 8 PM as her confession claimed.

Katsui's watch stopped at 8:00, yet station cameras place his arrival at 7:20 and the autopsy sets death between 7 and 9 -- the watch time is too conveniently exact, implying it was set and broken after a later killing.
